name: hover-image-list
title: Hover Image List
description: A text list that reveals a preview for the row you point at; the preview trails the cursor on desktop and sits beside the list on touch, with focus and reduced motion.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; title: string; meta?: string; preview: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The rows. preview is shown while a row is hovered or focused.

props.name: previewSize
props.description: Width and height of the preview in pixels.

props.name: follow
props.description: Let the preview trail the pointer on hover devices. Otherwise it stays beside the list.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
